Text.Text: The backroom circuit has lost its champion and its money. That's a cleaner fight trade than the one you found. You've finished my Crippling Defense trials. I have no further work for you here.
I book these trials for fighters with rank 50 in Spear. Finish that training, then come back. Good reach won't cover an unfinished guard.

Someone's booking maiming bouts behind the fight club without medics or rules. Bring me their ledger so the bookmakers can see what they're funding. Defeat six Crippling Defense Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina. I'll give you the Smuggler's Moon Fight Club Backrooms Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Crippling Defense.

Here's the Smuggler's Moon Fight Club Backrooms Key. Use '[Back Rooms]' in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Crippling Defense Adepts, then return with the Crippling Defense Backroom Bout Ledger.

Crippling Defense. The proper version's a thing of beauty. A guard that taxes every swing thrown against it, until the other fighter's paying rent just to keep his arms up. You'll learn it, that's the purse at the end of all this. The backroom version skips the discipline and goes straight for the tendons. Career-enders, every bout. That's what I want gone.

Use '[Back Rooms]' in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Crippling Defense Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina.

The adepts are young, hungry, and they've been sparring career-enders for months. They come in low, work the knees, and they don't stop when you're down, because nobody ever taught them to. Keep your feet wide and your temper cold. And if a fight feels easy, it's an audition. Theirs.

Defeat six Crippling Defense Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina.
You've defeated six Crippling Defense Adepts. Let me see the Crippling Defense Backroom Bout Ledger.
The book is back in honest hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using the ring's shock equipment in their bouts. Recover the regulator before they hurt anyone else with it. Defeat five Crippling Defense Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Ring Shock Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Defeat five Crippling Defense Specialists to secure the Crippling Defense Ring Shock Regulator, then return to me.

Shock plates under the canvas, wired to a regulator in the control box. Legitimate clubs use them for training drills. Low current, teaches footwork. Theirs is re-wired to drop a fighter mid-exchange so the guard they're selling looks unbeatable. That's the con. Half that circuit's fearsome reputation is a dial on a wall.

Muscle I've got. Standing, I've got. What I don't have is jurisdiction. This is the Smuggler's Moon, nobody does. But bookmakers are the closest thing to law the fight trade answers to. They pull odds on the backroom circuit, the money dries up, and money's the one kind of blood that crowd can't afford to lose. Every job I hand you feeds their file.

The specialists are ring engineers who fight like fighters, because they were fighters. They'll pull you onto the plates and dance you around the dial. Watch the corners of the canvas. The seams show where the plates sit. Fight them on bare floor and it's just a fight, five times over.

Defeat five Crippling Defense Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Ring Shock Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina.
You've defeated five Crippling Defense Specialists. Let me see the Crippling Defense Ring Shock Regulator.
One less rigged test to worry about. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

Their warden protects the backroom circuit. Take his pit sigil and break that protection. Defeat the Crippling Defense Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Cracked Pit Sigil; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Crippling Defense Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Crippling Defense Cracked Pit Sigil.

You've been fighting students of the guard. He's a source. Every swing you throw at him costs you. That's Crippling Defense done right: your offense becomes his purse. He'll let you spend yourself, then collect. The counter isn't cleverness, it's cash flow. Three fighters spending in turns, so nobody goes broke.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Crippling Defense Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

You'll challenge the warden in the Fight Club Backrooms. Accept the assignment, gather your help, then use the '???' challenge marker there. Don't mistake his invitation to fight alone for good advice.

Defeat the Crippling Defense Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Cracked Pit Sigil; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Crippling Defense Warden. Let me see the Crippling Defense Cracked Pit Sigil.
The warden's protection is broken. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The inner circle controls the money keeping these bouts alive. Bring me their payout chit. Defeat four members of the Crippling Defense Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Promoter's Payout Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina.

Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Defeat four members of the Crippling Defense Inner Circle to secure the Crippling Defense Promoter's Payout Chit, then return to me.

A matchmaker who used to book for me, two enforcers who came up through the maiming bill, and a moneyman nobody's ever seen fight, which worries me more than the ones I have seen. They know the club, they know the warren, and by now they know your name. Treat every empty room down there like it's holding its breath.

Everything that circuit pays for, it pays through that marker. Door crews, crooked medics, the rail men, the silence. Kill the payroll and loyalty dies the same hour. This is the Smuggler's Moon. Four bodies get replaced by breakfast, but frozen money stays frozen. That's why I want the chit and the table both.

The Crippling Defense Inner Circle fight together. Bring help if you can, and focus on one opponent at a time. Defeat four members to secure the Crippling Defense Promoter's Payout Chit; simultaneous kills aren't required.

Defeat four members of the Crippling Defense Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Crippling Defense Promoter's Payout Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina.
You've defeated four members of the Crippling Defense Inner Circle. Let me see the Crippling Defense Promoter's Payout Chit.
That closes the crew's account. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the circuit's final defense. Beat him in the Private Pit and we can close the book on these bouts. Defeat the Crippling Defense Master in Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Crippling Defense Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Once, up close, years back, when he was just a scary young spear on somebody else's card. A fighter twice his size threw forty strikes at him. He gave back six. The bout ended with the big man's arms dead at his sides and his career over, and the kid hadn't broken rhythm once. I signed him that night. That's my sin in all this, and it's why this last bout is personal bookkeeping.

I recommend two companions against the Crippling Defense Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

I recommend two companions against the Crippling Defense Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Defeat the Crippling Defense Master in Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Hyper Dive Cantina; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Crippling Defense Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The backroom circuit has lost its champion and its money. That's a cleaner fight trade than the one you found. You've earned the right to train Crippling Defense. Your final payment is ready.
Go over the job once more.
I'll defeat six Crippling Defense Adepts.
What kind of guard collects on a swing?
How do I get into the backrooms?
What are these adepts like in a fight?
I don't fight for free. Let me think on it.
Here's the Crippling Defense Backroom Bout Ledger.
Run the ring job by me again.
I'll defeat five Crippling Defense Specialists.
They're electrifying the rings?
Why do the bookmakers matter so much?
How do the specialists handle themselves?
My legs need a day. Then I'm in.
Here's the Crippling Defense Ring Shock Regulator.
Talk me through the warden again.
I'll defeat the Crippling Defense Warden.
What makes his guard the real thing?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Where do I challenge the warden?
I've got two names in mind. Give me time to call them.
Here's the Crippling Defense Cracked Pit Sigil.
Deal me the table job again.
I'll defeat four members of the Crippling Defense Inner Circle.
Who sits at the table?
What can one chit really do?
How will four of them fight me?
After the warden, I need a breather. A short one.
Here's the Crippling Defense Promoter's Payout Chit.
Talk me through the champion again.
I'll face the Crippling Defense Master and report back.
You've seen him fight. Tell me.
How do I beat a perfect guard?
What's waiting past the last gate?
Not tonight. A title bout deserves my best, and my best needs rest.
The Crippling Defense Master is defeated. Here's my report.
